## NVIDIA - Senior Software Engineer, Kubernetes Runtime

🔗 [Apply](https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nvidiaexternalcareersite/job/us-ca-remote/senior-software-engineer--kubernetes-runtime-and-release_jr2026573)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building Kubernetes runtime, release automation, and provider integrations for NVIDIA's GPU cloud infrastructure. Delivering reliable software across public clouds, GPU platforms, and new hardware.
Senior Software Engineer building NVIDIA's Kubernetes runtime and release systems for GPU cloud infrastructure
- Salary: $184,000 - $356,500 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Distributed Systems, Kubernetes, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors UK Skilled Worker visas.
- Build Go controllers and APIs to install, upgrade, and validate GPU cluster software
- Integrate components, define API contracts, and evolve Helm and Argo CD delivery toward controller-driven automation
- Build validation pipelines that inform release decisions across providers and GPU platforms
- Develop systems to allocate GPU capacity across validation runs and account for cloud reservations and quotas
- Improve qualification efficiency through reusable tests and clear failure reports
- Bring new providers and GPU hardware into production
- Resolve integration failures with partner teams
- Turn initial provisioning, upgrade, and operational checks into repeatable automation
- 6+ years building production infrastructure software or distributed systems
- Strong programming skills in Go or another language to build production systems, with willingness to work primarily in Go
- Kubernetes experience and depth in at least one area: controllers and operators, release automation, test and validation systems, or cloud integration
- Experience delivering engineering projects, diagnosing complex failures, and collaborating across teams
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Experience with controller-runtime, CRDs, and reconcilers is valuable but not required
- Experience with release qualification across multiple environments or platforms is valuable but not required
- Experience with GPU infrastructure, accelerated networking, or GPU scheduling is valuable but not required

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Kubernetes runtime, release automation, and provider integrations for NVIDIA's GPU cloud infrastructure. Delivering reliable software across public clouds, GPU platforms, and new hardware.
Senior Software Engineer building NVIDIA's Kubernetes runtime and release systems for GPU cloud infrastructure
Role description:
• Build Go controllers and APIs to install, upgrade, and validate GPU cluster software
• Integrate components, define API contracts, and evolve Helm and Argo CD delivery toward controller-driven automation
• Build validation pipelines that inform release decisions across providers and GPU platforms
• Develop systems to allocate GPU capacity across validation runs and account for cloud reservations and quotas
• Improve qualification efficiency through reusable tests and clear failure reports
• Bring new providers and GPU hardware into production
• Resolve integration failures with partner teams
• Turn initial provisioning, upgrade, and operational checks into repeatable automation
• Collaborate across Runtime, Release Engineering, and Provider Integration teams
• Influence what reaches production across NVIDIA's GPU cloud infrastructure
Role requirements:
• 6+ years building production infrastructure software or distributed systems
• Strong programming skills in Go or another language to build production systems, with willingness to work primarily in Go
• Kubernetes experience and depth in at least one area: controllers and operators, release automation, test and validation systems, or cloud integration
• Experience delivering engineering projects, diagnosing complex failures, and collaborating across teams
• BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
• Experience with controller-runtime, CRDs, and reconcilers is valuable but not required
• Experience with release qualification across multiple environments or platforms is valuable but not required
• Experience with GPU infrastructure, accelerated networking, or GPU scheduling is valuable but not required
• Experience bringing new hardware, regions, or cloud providers into production is valuable but not required
• Experience with resource allocation, leasing, fair-share scheduling, upstream integration, compatibility, or software supply chain integrity is valuable but not required
Benefits:
• Equity
• Benefits
Tech stack:
Cloud, Distributed Systems, Kubernetes, Go
